name: Vadu
notes: Wild beach north of Năvodari; shallow water, NE–SE winds onshore. Main Romanian kite spot, schools in summer.

name: Corbu
notes: Wild beach next to Vadu; shallow, works with NE–SE winds.

name: Mamaia Nord
notes: North end of Mamaia resort; NE–SE onshore winds, waves. Kite school in summer, crowded beach in July–August.
